summary: A victim sent 102000 USDC to a fraudulent wallet address after copying an address from transaction history that visually resembled the intended recipient address. The attacker used address poisoning techniques to insert a deceptive lookalike address into the wallet history.
user_mistake: Copied a recipient address from transaction history without verifying the full address
prevention: Verify full wallet addresses before confirming transfers/Use saved allowlisted addresses instead of copying from transaction history
